description: Returns only the verbatim paragraphs of one obligation (section) that contain the given terms. Inputs: `obligation_id`; `terms`, 1-6 short words or phrases ("cash-out", "credit score", "LTV"; abbreviations are expanded; numbers match as words or digits, so "five years" finds "five (5) years"); optional `max_passages`. Each passage has `verbatim` (the regulator's exact text), `offset` (its position in the section's text), `canonical_citation` (the pinpoint cite, where derivable) and `heading_path` (every heading above it, e.g. "vi. No Cash-Out Refinances > (A) Rate and Term > (i) Standard"). A match inside a table returns the whole table (`table: true`; `table_layout: "flattened"` when the source lost its layout and cells may not line up). A passage ending in a colon includes the list it introduces (`list_included: true`). `truncated` means more passages matched than were returned. No passages means no paragraph contains the terms as given; it is not a statement about the rule. `currency` is null or a version/status signal (dual-version, pending, revision-pending, superseded, expired...). On an FHA section HUD's Update 18 revises, `version` ("in-force" or "update-18-optional") says which text this is and `other_version` identifies the other.

terms.description: 1-6 short terms, e.g. ["cash-out", "credit score"]; not document text.

name: find_in_section

authority.description: The document and section title as published.

canonical_citation.description: The citation in the regulator's style (e.g. "4000.1 II.A.5.d", "B3-3.3-07"), or null.

canonical_id.description: Set when this register is a same-text copy of that register.

coverage_tier.description: How completely the corpus holds the document.

currency.description: null, or a version/status signal {kind, headline, detail, effective_date, mandatory_date, expires_on, as_of, links}; kind e.g. dual-version, pending, revision-pending, superseded, superseded-in-part, modified-by, expired.

error.description: Present only on an error or refusal: not_found, ambiguous, unparsed, empty_terms, unknown_playbook, unknown_reference, offset_out_of_range, daily_capacity_reached.

fallback.description: On daily_capacity_reached: where the full corpus can be downloaded.

guidance.description: On a refusal or empty search: the server's explanation.

hint.description: On an error: the server's explanation.

merged_into_lists.description: Matching paragraphs merged into lists with their lead-in.

merged_into_tables.description: Matching paragraphs merged into whole tables.

notice.description: Terms notice: research use only, not legal advice.

other_version.description: On a dual-version section: the other version ({obligation_id, version, dates}).

page_url.description: The section's page on claudeforcompliance.com (verbatim text, currency notices, link to the regulator).

passages.description: Matching verbatim passages, in section order.

canonical_citation.description: The citation in the regulator's style (e.g. "4000.1 II.A.5.d", "B3-3.3-07"), or null.

continues_at.description: Offset where the table continues, when table_complete is false.

heading.description: The nearest heading above (verbatim), or null.

heading_path.description: Every heading above, joined by " > ", or null.

list_included.description: The passage ends in a colon and includes the list it introduces.

table_complete.description: false when the table may continue past the passage.

table_layout.description: "flattened": the source lost its table layout; cells may not line up.

passages_available.description: Passages the matches make (tables and lists merged).

resets.description: On daily_capacity_reached: when capacity resets (00:00 UTC).

resolved_from_alias.description: The retired obligation id requested; its text is now at obligation_id.

source_url.description: The regulator's URL for the document.

expanded_to.description: Spellings and abbreviations it expanded to.

toc_omitted.description: The section's table-of-contents line was omitted.

truncated.description: More passages matched than were returned.

version.description: On a dual-version section: {label: in-force | update-18-optional, dates, note}.
